title: server.ts mixes ES import and require for './app'
evidence: src/server.ts:3 imports setDb from './app', then src/server.ts:20 re-loads the module via require('./app') to get app — two module-load styles for the same module
suggestion: Import { app, setDb } once at the top; drop the require call
